function.description: Returns the list of discovery jobs for the given Discovery ID. The results can be optionally filtered based on IP. Discovery ID can be obtained using the "Get Discoveries by range" API.
function.name: api_getListOfDiscoveriesByDiscoveryId

ipAddress.description: Filter records based on IP address

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

cliStatus.description: CLI status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'

discoveryStatus.description: Status of the discovery. Available options are: MANAGED_DEVICES, UNMANAGED_DEVICES, DISCARDED_DEVICES

endTime.description: End time for the discovery job

httpStatus.description: HTTP status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'

inventoryCollectionStatus.description: Last known inventory collection status of the device. Available values are 'MANAGED', 'ABORTED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL COLLECTION FAILURE' and 'NOT-AVAILABLE'

inventoryReachabilityStatus.description: Last known reachability status of the device. Available values are : 'Reachable', 'Unreachable', 'PingReachable' and 'NOT-AVAILABLE'

netconfStatus.description: NETCONF status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'

pingStatus.description: Ping status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED

snmpStatus.description: SNMP status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'
